tools.description: Create a new comment on a GitLab merge request with optional line positioning. For diff comments, use position object with 'new_path' (file path) and 'new_line' (line number). Example: {new_path: 'src/file.go', new_line: 42}. SHA values are auto-fetched if not provided.

project_id.description: GitLab project ID or URL-encoded path (e.g., 'my-group/my-project')

merge_request_id.description: Merge request IID (internal ID) - the number shown in the MR URL and title

EXAMPLE: {new_path: 'src/main.go', new_line: 125}. SHA values auto-fetched if omitted. Common mistakes: use 'new_path' not 'file_path', use 'new_line' not 'line_number'.

tools.name: gitlab_pages_manage
tools.description:
Comprehensive GitLab Pages management tool. Manage Pages settings, custom domains, SSL certificates, and deployment configurations.

**Core Capabilities:**
• **Pages Settings**: View, update, and unpublish GitLab Pages
• **Domain Management**: Add, update, verify, and remove custom domains
• **SSL/TLS**: Configure automatic SSL certificates and custom certificates
• **Publishing Control**: Enable/disable unique domains and force HTTPS
• **Administrative**: List all domains across GitLab instance (admin only)

**Key Features:**
• Automatic SSL certificate management with Let's Encrypt integration
• Custom domain verification and DNS configuration
• HTTPS enforcement and security settings
• Primary domain redirection configuration
• Comprehensive domain status monitoring

**Common Use Cases:**
• Set up custom domains for project websites
• Configure SSL certificates for secure access
• Manage multiple domains for the same project
• Monitor domain verification status
• Control Pages publishing and access settings

action.description: Action to perform: get_settings (view current settings), update_settings (modify Pages configuration), unpublish (remove Pages site), list_domains (project domains), list_all_domains (all domains - admin only), get_domain (specific domain details), create_domain (add custom domain), update_domain (modify domain settings), verify_domain (validate domain ownership), delete_domain (remove domain)

domain.description: Domain name (required for domain-specific actions like get_domain, create_domain, etc.)

pages_unique_domain_enabled.description: Enable unique domain feature for GitLab Pages (for update_settings action)

pages_https_only.description: Force HTTPS for all Pages access (for update_settings action)

pages_primary_domain.description: Set primary domain for redirect configuration (for update_settings action)

auto_ssl_enabled.description: Enable automatic SSL certificate provisioning via Let's Encrypt (for create_domain/update_domain)

certificate.description: Custom SSL certificate in PEM format (for create_domain/update_domain with custom certificates)

key.description: Private key for custom SSL certificate in PEM format (for create_domain/update_domain with custom certificates)
